PAC — THE INTRO

The comic-window cutscene, beat for beat as dictated. Not rushed. Every beat breathes.

WORDS YOU'LL MEET Strength — physical damage, single-target and AoE alike. · Vitality — the life total, the size of the life pool. · Spirit — resource recovery: how your resources come back. · Intellect — the mental stat: spell damage and resource increase. · Agility — dodge: avoiding the hit entirely. · Speciality — ability power, the mythic-ability enabler's house. · Nature — the world's own forces. · Shade — one of a stat's 3 colour shades; heroes sit under their strongest sub-stat. · + Food Slot — stored fruit, eaten on demand. · + Shield Slot — a shield that blocks. · + Movement Effect Slot — your movement effect. · + Car Slot — your car. · + Weapon Slot — your weapon. · + Pet Slot — your pet, who fights beside you. · + Orb Slot — copied powers, held ready. · White pellets — the eat-and-gather currency. · Coins — character-based: buy shop stuff and skills. · Sonic rings — from achievements: unlock characters. · Arcade tickets — account-wide and scarce: cosmetics and build-your-own-character.

Art: pencil & pencil-crayon on school notebook paper, per the locked style sheets. Panel 13 (“The Snack”) is a placeholder card — the beat is canon, its artwork is still to come. Panels advance at the intro’s own pace in PLAY mode (≈6.5s per beat, 97 seconds end to end), or step through by hand.
